description: Find nation-state threat actors in the ThreatNexus roster by name or alias, or list them by origin country, motivation, exploited CVE or ATT&CK technique. Returns short profiles with links; use get_actor for a full dossier. Lists are paged: when "next_offset" is a number, call again with that offset to get the rest ("count" is the full total). An alias shared by several actors returns status "ambiguous" with candidates.

country.description: Origin country as ThreatNexus records it, e.g. "Iran", "Russia", "North Korea".

cve.description: Only actors whose dossier lists this CVE, e.g. "CVE-2023-23397".

offset.description: Skip this many results — pass the previous page's next_offset.

query.description: Name or alias, e.g. "APT34", "OilRig". Optional when a filter is given.

technique.description: Only actors whose dossier lists this ATT&CK technique; a base id (T1566) also matches its sub-techniques.

name: search_actors
title: Search ThreatNexus threat actors
